\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,shapes.geometric,shapes.multipart}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  >=Latex,
  node distance=18mm and 24mm,
  decision/.style={diamond split,draw,thick,aspect=1.35,
    minimum width=30mm,minimum height=20mm,inner xsep=4pt,
    inner ysep=3pt,align=center,fill=yellow!12},
  action/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=20mm,
    minimum height=9mm,fill=blue!7}
]
  \node[decision] (gate) {request\nodepart{lower}valid?};
  \node[action,right=of gate] (accept) {accept};
  \node[action,below=of gate] (reject) {reject};

  \draw[-Latex,thick] (gate) -- node[above] {yes} (accept);
  \draw[-Latex,thick] (gate) -- node[right] {no} (reject);
  \draw[blue!70!black] (gate.lower) -- ++(-12mm,0)
    node[left] {lower anchor};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
